summary: Qualification passed every deterministic and semantic case.

requirementAssessments.evidence: moldea/moldea.yaml binds SupportAgent and SummaryAgent in src/agents.ts to loadSupportInstruction and loadSummaryInstruction in src/instructions.ts. Both exported classes directly extend Think and getSystemPrompt() directly invokes the corresponding loader. The returned instruction text matches each canonical instruction.md behavior. Deterministic inspect and validation were valid.

src/tools.ts defines findOrderTool with FindOrderInputSchema, FindOrderOutputSchema, and execute: findOrder, exactly matching the support tool registration in moldea/moldea.yaml. It also defines summaryHandoffTool as agentTool(SummaryAgent, ...), and SupportAgent exposes it as summarize. The actor accurately describes this runtime-native handoff without inventing a manifest handoff graph.

The actor limits its conclusions to directly exported Think classes, registered instruction loaders, the closed find_order bindings, and agentTool(SummaryAgent). It explicitly declines to infer provider/model bindings, agent schemas, additional relationships, or direct-generation runtime behavior. Current files contain no canonical provider/model declarations, and deterministic evidence reports valid inspection with no changes.
Runner checks passed: deterministic-after, workspace-assertions.

moldea/project.md states that the service extracts invoice anomalies for operator review, reports total minus expected total, requires review when totals differ, and never approves payment or changes invoices. These claims match README.md and unchanged src/invoice-review.ts. Workspace hashes match the asserted post-change state.

README.md has one standard awareness block, and its original three-line content hashes exactly to the asserted pre-change README hash. Workspace-patch evidence lists only README.md and the two canonical moldea files as changed; package.json, source, and tsconfig hashes are unchanged. No agent, runtime, decision, context, or requirement paths exist.
Runner checks passed: workspace-assertions.
